WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS max_month_start
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
months AS (
    SELECT
        generate_series(
            (b.max_month_start - INTERVAL '12 months')::date,
            b.max_month_start,
            INTERVAL '1 month'
        )::date AS month_start
    FROM bounds AS b
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month_start,
        ABS(SUM(op.payment_value))::numeric AS total_revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_payments AS op
        ON op.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0)::numeric AS total_revenue
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue AS r
    ON r.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;
